description: POOL_RESERVATION_CEILING=5 is a second hand-maintained mirror of the pool member count, not coupled to the pool registration by an assertion (unlike the array, which this PR now guards); adding a 6th part leaves it silently at 5 (perf/serialization regression).

The generalized reconciliation checks each part's contribution against that part's own summary (per-part self-consistency); no pre/post-split grand-total conservation invariant, so a wholesale-deleted assertion during the split would reconcile cleanly.
